items.topic: Which scenario does this work target?
items.context: The spec.json has no scope field set. If this becomes a real scenario, it needs its own directory. If it extends an existing scenario (e.g., swarm-manager), the scope should point there. This decision is required before acceptance criteria can be defined.

options.label: New standalone scenario (scenarios/effort-test/)
options.rationale: Creates a fresh scenario directory. Appropriate if this is a distinct tool or service with its own API/CLI/UI.

options.label: Extension of swarm-manager (scenarios/swarm-manager/)
options.rationale: If effort estimation is a feature of swarm-manager rather than a separate service, scope it there. Tighter integration with backlog metadata.

options.label: Extension of another existing scenario
options.rationale: Specify which scenario in the freeform field.

options.label: Not applicable — this is a test/placeholder item
options.rationale: If round-001 decision d1 resolved to option C (placeholder), no scope is needed and the item can be archived.

items.context: Once scope is known, acceptance_allow and acceptance_deny globs constrain what the executing agent can modify. This prevents unintended side effects. Cannot be fully answered until d1 (scope) is decided, but capturing intent now.

options.label: Broad: scenarios/<target>/**
options.rationale: Allow changes anywhere in the target scenario. Appropriate for greenfield creation.

options.label: Targeted subdirectories only
options.rationale: Restrict to specific paths (e.g., api/, cli/). Appropriate for extending an existing scenario. Specify paths in freeform.

options.label: Cross-scenario: multiple directories
options.rationale: If this touches shared packages (packages/proto/, etc.) in addition to a scenario. Specify paths in freeform.

options.label: Not applicable
options.rationale: Select if this is a placeholder/test item.

items.text: Round 1 has 5 unanswered decisions that are prerequisites to making progress on the plan. Please answer round-001 decisions first (especially d1: what is 'Effort Test'?), then this round's scope and acceptance decisions can be finalized.

plan_updates: No plan.md changes this round — all sections remain TBD pending round-001 answers. Round 2 adds the missing scope and acceptance criteria decisions required by the initialization workflow.
